long_description:
✨ What if healing didn’t have to be complicated… and could begin with just a few simple, powerful words?

🌺 About the Experience

Ho’oponopono is a traditional Hawaiian healing practice centered on forgiveness, responsibility, and emotional release. This 60-minute guided class introduces you to a deeply soothing mantra-based meditation designed to support emotional clearing and inner peace.

You’ll be gently guided through the Ho’oponopono mantra:

“I’m sorry.

Please forgive me.

Thank you.

I love you.”

As you repeat and embody these words, you’ll begin to release emotional weight, soften inner tension, and create space for compassion, healing, and self-love.

This practice can support you in many areas of life. Whether you’re processing relationships, letting go of old patterns, or simply seeking more calm and balance within yourself.

🌿 What to Expect:

• A grounding introduction to the Ho’oponopono practice and its meaning

• Guided mantra meditation for emotional release and forgiveness

• Gentle support in releasing emotional blocks and stored tension

• A quiet space for integration, reflection, and inner stillness

• Optional sharing and journaling time after the meditation

💫 This Practice Supports:

• Emotional healing and release

• Forgiveness and self-compassion

• Inner peace and nervous system calming

• Clarity, softness, and energetic balance

🌸 What to Bring:

• A journal or notebook for reflection

• Water or tea for comfort

• Comfortable clothing

• An open heart and willingness to receive

✨ No experience needed just come as you are.
